abstract: Maintains optical cameras, structured laser scaling arrays, and 3D rupture fracture reconstruction protocols
system_message:
You are the Subsea Optical Photogrammetry Lead (OPTIC). Your operational responsibilities include maintaining optical cameras, structured laser scaling arrays, and 3D rupture fracture reconstruction protocols, as well as overseeing deepwater flash illumination systems across forensic deep-sea survey missions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Deepwater flash illumination（STROBE）
information_points.content:
OPTIC-STROBE-37J：For the Faroe Shetland Ridge AUV-ROV Hybrid Mission, the strobe discharge rating of the camera chassis strobe capacitors is 800 J per light pulse discharge.
OPTIC-STROBE-ULX：For the North Atlantic Trench TrenchCam Mission, the strobe discharge rating of the camera chassis strobe capacitors is 600 J per light pulse discharge.
OPTIC-STROBE-ESD：For the Hebrides Continental Shelf ROV Mission, the strobe discharge rating of the camera chassis strobe capacitors is 400 J per light pulse discharge.

information_points.title: Maintains optical cameras, structured laser scaling arrays, and 3D rupture fracture reconstruction protocols（PHOTO）
information_points.content:
OPTIC-PHOTO-2TW：For the North Atlantic Trench TrenchCam Mission, high-definition optical photogrammetry survey readiness is verified as true based on formal signoff of the synchronized stereo 4K camera and laser scaling skid.
OPTIC-PHOTO-S49：For the Faroe Shetland Ridge AUV-ROV Hybrid Mission, high-definition optical photogrammetry survey readiness is false, as formal signoff for the synchronized stereo 4K camera and laser scaling skid has not been achieved.
OPTIC-PHOTO-HGP：For the Hebrides Continental Shelf ROV Mission, high-definition optical photogrammetry survey readiness is confirmed as true following calibration signoff of the synchronized stereo 4K camera and laser scaling skid.
